content: Bapitaisi peao hayeke hali Dionima꞉ pi waleekeeki
Koto natena꞉ta꞉ mo hande bapitaisi peao hayeke hali Dionima꞉ mo Diudiana꞉ hapiki kenke pa꞉ta꞉ a꞉pa hata꞉ pi kini pea walolo alota꞉
Mo hande hepenina꞉ Kilu Tombuao Hala꞉ ekita꞉ teke pa꞉ta꞉ ya꞉la꞉ma꞉ ika꞉ hoke haumanu paeyao mina꞉pa꞉lao hoki wala꞉pa꞉peke leekeme.
Do Dioni pa꞉ta꞉ta꞉ mo hande potopede hali Aisayama꞉ pi ma꞉nda꞉ la꞉ wiekeme. Koto la꞉ wieke pita꞉ dupa.

content.text: Ma꞉nda꞉ halima꞉ mo hapiki kenke pa꞉ta꞉ hata꞉ pi taka꞉lake lo hala꞉me.
Ipikana꞉ma꞉ alota꞉ Mo Tekehalina꞉ pota꞉ pilaowapa꞉peke.
Ipiki epeke alena꞉ yapena꞉ ipika꞉ pota꞉ wopu tikitiki yawapa꞉peke ala꞉me leekeme.

content: Dioni ipika꞉ yameeke dauta꞉ mo kemolo itikima꞉ wepiki dau yameekeme. Ipika꞉ hakota꞉ kao yonkeleke wepiki hako yameekeme. Ipika꞉ ne manuta꞉ odouwamanu make mo pole pukini hapeke hanimanu make no hayekeme.
Mo Diutuseleme da wanda꞉hali make Diudia kenke wanda꞉hali make mo Diodani ikali tea꞉na꞉ pelia peeke wanda꞉hali make ota꞉ paeyao ipiki pa꞉ta꞉ tayaemekeme.
Kutupata꞉ mo wanda꞉halima꞉ ika꞉ hoke haumanu ka꞉la꞉polo liaena꞉ ikita꞉ Dionima꞉ mo Diodani ikali pa꞉ta꞉ bapitaisi peayekeme.

Mo hande Pa꞉tisi tapake make Sa꞉dusi tapake make koto tapake yaapona꞉ haliweki wopu Dionima꞉ bapitaisi peaena꞉ epemekeeki handaa ipikana꞉ma꞉ iki pa꞉ta꞉ alota꞉ Ketoma꞉ handeke some hombo iki pa꞉ta꞉ mo Koda꞉ma꞉ a̱i̱ taapolo pa꞉la꞉ panisi tieke wendia꞉pekee pita꞉ epima꞉ lakia꞉pe.
Mo ika꞉ hoke haumanu hoki walaa ota꞉ mina꞉pa꞉laaseme hau peneme yaasa꞉ ekimanu homeke pu hapa꞉peke.

Eipoloha꞉ma꞉ta꞉ nika꞉ meie lomeka꞉na꞉ta꞉ mo Koda꞉ma꞉ kulu pa꞉la꞉ hoke yenkita꞉ wendulumekee hone na wia꞉pa꞉peke. Lono opie. Koda꞉ma꞉ta꞉ do ula꞉ toopimanu mea Eipoloha꞉ma꞉na꞉ wekiwandiki au lapeke ya꞉la꞉me alome.
Mo timanu ika꞉ teke yoka꞉ poka꞉ bepe peaapeke teita꞉ do tikitiki yao ula꞉ handa꞉e. Ti homeke homekema꞉ ipika꞉ epeke kiliki na eiyo haya꞉ka꞉na꞉ta꞉ kota꞉ pokaa tina꞉ yankilieke.

I̱ma꞉ta꞉ ika꞉ hoke haumanu mina꞉pa꞉laemekeeki peneme yaaluekema꞉ ikalima꞉ bapitaisi peaowalopate mo ya hoki nane ipilia꞉ halima꞉ta꞉ mo Holi Sipitidi pita꞉ ti tala꞉eki yaapoma꞉ iki bapitaisi pealieke. Mo someta꞉ I̱ ota꞉ lombeipiki some halekena꞉ ipika꞉ anke dake kone I̱ma꞉ mea tiaapeke ana꞉ na pa꞉la꞉me.

Ipikana꞉ma꞉ mo hande widi kilikina꞉ ambuku napeke yaapo putupa alu puluekema꞉ pana꞉pulu pa꞉la꞉ sa꞉sata꞉ ipika꞉ kikina꞉ miniki hala꞉me. Ipika꞉ widi kiliki epekeeki paeyaota꞉ ipika꞉ widi napeke u hala꞉ da pa꞉ta꞉ momba꞉la wilieke. Pate mo ambuku paeyaota꞉ tina꞉ pana꞉pu yankilieke. Koto tita꞉ na paeyeke pa to halieke. Koto pi manuta꞉ Dionima꞉ iki pa꞉ta꞉ leekeme.
Koto pita꞉ma꞉ta꞉ Yesu mo Ka꞉lili kenke mina꞉pa꞉lao Dionima꞉ ipiki bapitaisi peaena꞉ mo Diodani ikali pa꞉ta꞉ epeekeme.
Kutu piekepate Yesuna꞉ hone topo pina꞉yeke Dionima꞉ ipiki pa꞉ta꞉ dupa leekeme. Nakana꞉ma꞉ I̱ bapitaisi peapekealeo. Pa neketa꞉ I̱ma꞉ bapitaisi peano I̱ pa꞉ta꞉ epeka꞉ta꞉me leekeme.

Koto leekepate Yesuma꞉ ipika꞉ pi hombo peaaso hata꞉ alota꞉ Pina꞉ma꞉ hone ma꞉nda꞉ na wiki. Do pulu polopa꞉ hauta꞉ Koda꞉na꞉ hone pa꞉la꞉ hauna꞉ pitolo pitolopa꞉me. Koto leekeeki Dionima꞉ opuaata꞉ A꞉pa꞉la꞉me bapitaisi peanoe leekeme.

Yesu bapitaisi peao paeyeketa꞉ koto kone mo ikali mina꞉pa꞉lao tea꞉ nane yapeekeme. Kutu pitolo haena꞉ta꞉ koto kone oli ya akolopa wiaata꞉ mo hande Koda꞉na꞉ Sipitidi melipu tupa꞉ hola꞉pa꞉niao ipika꞉ loke manda tapepeekeeki handeekeme.
Kutaa oli ya nanema꞉ pi ho̱la̱꞉make homekema꞉ pi alo alota꞉ Dota꞉ ya pukipiki wekie. I̱ma꞉ ipiki pa꞉ta꞉ ta꞉na꞉ma꞉ wopu homolome laa pi la꞉niaeyekeme.
